title_zh: 选定只到开放庭院的历史步行路线

scenario.label_zh: 核对历史步行的参观边界
scenario.goal_zh: 确认纪念碑与清真寺庭院路线及室内限制，选定不进入祈祷区的参观安排

context_zh: 游客法拉向虚构小镇旅游处工作人员丹尼尔询问下午的历史步行路线。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Can we see the riverside monument and the old mosque on the same walk?

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.text: Yes. The public path passes the monument first, then leads to the mosque's outer courtyard.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Are visitors allowed inside this afternoon? We don't want to interrupt anything.

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.text: The notice from the hosts says the prayer area is closed to tours today. The courtyard remains open until four.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: That's fine. We're interested in the outside of the building. Is there a sign showing where visitors should stop?

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.text: There is, at the inner gate. Please follow it, and ask the host there if anything is unclear.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: We'll take that route and stay in the open courtyard. Could you mark the public path on our map?

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.text: Certainly. I've marked the turn after the monument and the return path to the square.
